crossRefs.note: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,
and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He…

parallels.note: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

translations.web: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
translations.bsb: So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,
translations.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
translations.asv: And they went away, and found a colt tied at the door without in the open street; and they loose him.
